name: Will an ADU feasibility consultation include a cost estimate?

mainEntity.name: Will an ADU feasibility consultation include a cost estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many ADU feasibility consultations include a preliminary cost estimate based on typical construction costs for similar projects in your area. This estimate is usually a broad range, not a fixed bid, as it depends on final design choices and material selections. Hometelligent provides realistic cost considerations for various ADU types within our service regions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, preliminary cost estimates are often included, offering a broad range based on typical construction costs in your area.
